title: N -W F P Finance Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2003
ACT XIII OF 2003
NORTH WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2003
An Act to amend
the North-West Frontier
Province Finance
Ordinance, 2002.
[Gazette of
N.W.F.P., Extraordinary
18th
October; 2003]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis-1/2003/30160,
dated 18-10-2003.--The North-West Frontier Province Finance (Amendment)
Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on the 1st October, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
the North West Frontier Province on 13th October, 2003 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Finance (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2003
An Act to amend

Ordinance, 2002.
[Gazette of
N.W.F.P., Extraordinary
18th
October; 2003]
No.PA/N.-W.F.P./Legis-1/2003/30160,
dated 18-10-2003.--The North-West Frontier Province Finance (Amendment)
Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of North-West Frontier
Province on the 1st October, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
the North West Frontier Province on 13th October, 2003 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
It is hereby enacted as follows
2. Addition of a new section
to N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXIII of 2002.---In the North-West Frontier
Province Finance Ordinance, 2002, (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No.XXIII of 2002), after
section 4, the following new section shall be added namely:
"5. Power to make rules.----Government
may make rules to carry out the purposes of section, 4 of the Ordinance.".
